headline: Public hearing on Bristol Little League's proposed Peck Park Improvement Projects, plus softball leases and a McCabe Waters concession building agreement.
summary: The agenda also includes a conceptual design for the Jim Cleveland Wildflower Field and a memo on part-time and seasonal wage increases, which will go to the Salary Committee.
items: Annual review of Bristol Parks, Recreation, Youth and Community Services policies
Superintendent's report, including project updates, year-to-date financials, and NVCOG Tree Canopy Assessment 2016-2023
Public hearing on Bristol Little League's proposed Peck Park Improvement Projects
Bristol Boys Little League softball lease agreement, 2027-2031
Bristol Girls Little League softball lease agreement, 2027-2031
Conceptual design for the Jim Cleveland Wildflower Field
Part-time/seasonal wage increases memo, referred to Salary Committee
Reports from the Fund Development & Advocacy, Policy & Strategy, and Finance committees, and the City Council liaison
location: City Hall Meeting Room 1-2, 111 North Main Street, Bristol, CT 06010
